title: Hanasato Minori — Falling With Honor〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Look! Over there!
That claw machine!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I thought so! It's usually six tries for 500 yen, but you get eight tries if you go now!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, you're right! Why didn't the machine we used just earlier give us this kind of deal?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I've got a good feeling about this one...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Do you want to give it another try, Hanasato?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, I want another go at PenPyon!
Would that be alright?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I say why not?
I'm still a bit salty over our last attempt.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sure, we can make a stop before we head out.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank you!!
Alright, we're definitely getting it this time!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, that looks like a good spot.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, we should be able to make it stand up and roll over...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, it's pushing PenPyon up a bit.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Now it just needs to roll over and...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, it's stuck standing!
It's not moving like we expected!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh wow!
She got the claw around the entire plushie!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What? Why wasn't it able to get a hold of it?! There's totally something wrong with this machine!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I guess you're having trouble too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Trouble? No, this machine's the problem! If that's how it's gonna play...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Your phone...?
What do you plan on doing, Ena...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: One of my brother's friends is really good at winning stuff from claw machines, so I'm gonna ask about what we should do through him!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'll send a pic over of your machine too, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm gonna try my best too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And we'll be here cheering you on.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No... I still can't get it!!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, I got reply from my brother...!
There's a part about your machine too, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Let's see... In your case, Minori...
You're supposed to grab it by the hat on its head and gradually move it towards the prize chute.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Its hat?! Yeah, it's true that PenPyon's wearing a little top hat...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What if you're supposed to do that because the hat's sturdier than the plushie itself? That way even if the arm is weak, you could still get it to move.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, now I see!
I'm gonna give it a try, Ena!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, I think I've got a good idea too, so I'm gonna get back to it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sorry, Ichika, but can you stand next to the machine to spot how my claw's lining up?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I'm not sure if I'll be of any help, but...
Would you like me to do the same...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Alright, here goes nothing!
Aim for the hat... First, my horizontal position...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, I'll tell you when to stop.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, now we just need to get the claw to hook onto the top hat...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
It's up...!
Even though it wouldn't budge at all when we tried to get it to roll over...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That was amazing! It's a lot closer to the chute now! Two more tries tops and I think we've got it!
